children: According to ChainCatcher, Canton has approved a plan to extend the CC token-burning mechanism to its mainnet. The institutional blockchain network plans to use token burns instead of its existing licensing-fee model, with burns carried out on dedicated synchronizers. The rollout will be phased, with the first phase tentatively scheduled to begin in the first quarter of 2027.

title: Canton Approves CC Burn Mechanism for Mainnet, First Phase Planned for Q1 2027
